_comment: The store pictures: the background and the headline of each screen.
storeframe draws them (https://github.com/andiwand/storeframe); see it for the geometry.
With "arc": true, the images get the dashed path of the sun across the gallery.
One entry per screen, in the order of the store, with the names that the UI tests
write. `headline` has two lines for each locale: the first line is light, the
second line is bold. The backgrounds go through one day, from the evening to the
night, like the dashed path of the sun across the gallery.
